errors.evidence: The chart displays data for five entities (УниКредит Булбанк, Банка ДСК, ПИБ, Пощенска банка, ОББ вкл. СИБ), not four.
The line for 'УниКредит Булбанк' uses square markers, not diamond-shaped (ромбовидни) ones. The diamond markers are used for 'Банка ДСК'.
The light orange line for 'УниКредит Булбанк' ends at a value just below 40% (around 38%) in 2027, not 30%.
The peak for the dark blue line ('Пощенска банка') in 2012 is closer to 90% (approx. 88%), not 80%.
The light red line ('ОББ вкл. СИБ') does not have a peak in 2016. Its value in 2016 is around 60%. The second peak of over 100% occurs in 2017.
The light red line ('ОББ вкл. СИБ') stabilizes around 40% at the end of the period, not 20-30%.
